---
title: "Projects"
listing:
  contents:
    - "*.qmd"
    - links.yml
  type: grid
  grid-columns: 3
  # `image` is optional per entry. Cards without a real thumbnail get a designed
  # A(I) monogram tile (theme/shared.scss keys it on the absence of
  # .thumbnail-image so it applies to both entry types), so a missing image reads
  # as intentional rather than as an empty grey box.
  fields: [title, author, date, description, categories, tools, image]
  field-display-names:
    tools: "Tools"
  sort: "date desc"
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: true
  page-size: 24
---
